parsed.overall_notes: High scripted_example_fraction in S5 (notebook-dictated code and examples) contrasts with elevated argumentative_risk in S4/S6 around evaluative pros/cons and normative best practices; sources overlap on CoALA-inspired taxonomy yielding moderate independence but high canonicity for the semantic/episodic/procedural framing, explaining persistent depth gaps in case studies despite tavily saturation.
